clue.text: God appearing in an election round?

parts.note: the indefinite article an gives the single letter A
an election is a poll, a counting of votes
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Asks which deity turns up in a round of voting.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek and Roman deity of the sun, music and prophecy is a god.

clue.text: American expression for bus station?

parts.note: a term is a word or expression
something American is found in the US, giving IN US

explanation.surface: Asks what Americans call a bus station.
explanation.walkthrough: The question reads as a request for an American synonym; instead the clue is split into an expression (TERM) and the phrase 'in the US'.
explanation.definitionFit: The end of the line where buses start and stop is their final depot or station.

clue.text: Silent shareholder out East for example

parts.note: someone out cold or out for the night is asleep
in bridge East plays with West, so East is a partner

explanation.surface: A quiet investor who is away in the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the four players are named North, South, East and West, and East and West play as a pair.
explanation.definitionFit: An investor who puts money into a business but takes no active role is a silent shareholder.

clue.text: Picture educational establishment with area for English

indicators.note: putting one letter for another means replacing it, here the English letter swapped out for area

parts.note: a college is an educational establishment

explanation.surface: Describes a picture of a college campus.
explanation.definitionFit: An artwork made by sticking scraps of paper and photographs onto a backing is a kind of picture.

clue.text: Side with weak ruler? Innovative approach to solving problem

parts.note: lateral means to the side
thin can mean weak, as in a thin excuse
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: Siding with a feeble monarch is offered as a creative way out of a fix.
explanation.definitionFit: Approaching a puzzle indirectly and creatively, rather than step by step, is a well-known innovative problem-solving method.

clue.text: Jack hopes somehow to become famous carpenter

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in a pack of cards

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters of hopes reach their result by some unstated rearrangement

explanation.surface: An ordinary Jack dreams of becoming a renowned woodworker.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Gospels the husband of Mary, mother of Jesus, was a carpenter in Nazareth.

clue.text: Killer a tailless bird upended

indicators.note: in a down entry, upended means the letters are read from the bottom up
tailless means the bird word loses its final letter

parts.note: a crow is a bird

explanation.surface: A murderous bird that has lost its tail and been turned upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailless' cuts CROW to CRO; A + CRO is ACRO, which 'upended' turns around.
explanation.definitionFit: The black-and-white marine mammal is popularly called the killer whale, so Killer is a fair nickname.

clue.text: Son breaks mirror in recess

indicators.note: the son letter breaks into the mirror word, splitting it open

parts.note: to ape is to mirror or copy

explanation.surface: A boy smashes a mirror hung in an alcove.
explanation.definitionFit: A semicircular vaulted alcove at the end of a church is an architectural recess.

clue.text: One good to leave White House ladies?

indicators.note: the one and good letters are told to leave, so they are taken out

parts.note: an igloo is a house built of white snow
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Asks whether a single good woman must quit the President's residence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'White House' looks like the President's home but is a snow house, an IGLOO.
explanation.definitionFit: The ladies is the women's toilet, and a toilet is informally a lavatory in British speech.

clue.text: On ship notice pig brought in

indicators.note: the pig is brought in, placed inside the notice

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
a boar is a male pig

explanation.surface: A notice announces that a pig has been taken onto a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a ship, train or plane as a passenger is to be on board.

clue.text: Meat in iron container perhaps served thus?

indicators.note: the meat goes in the iron, which surrounds it
the iron acts as the container holding the meat

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: Meat cooked in an iron pan might be presented this way.
explanation.definitionFit: Food covered in spirit and set alight at the table is presented in a dramatic flaming style.

clue.text: Loyal subject — bloke from Belgian city?

parts.note: Liège is a city in eastern Belgium
a bloke is a man

explanation.surface: A faithful subject who happens to come from a city in Belgium.
explanation.definitionFit: In feudal times a vassal bound to serve his lord was a loyal subject.

clue.text: Revolutionary leaders located in rallies round France

parts.note: to have located something is to have found it

indicators.note: the rallies word goes round France, enclosing its letter

parts.note: rallies means gathers, as troops are gathered
F is the international abbreviation for France

explanation.surface: Revolutionary chiefs tracked down at rallies around France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' suggests a French anagram but here belongs to the definition: the American Revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: The men who led the American Revolution and drafted the US Constitution are known by this title.

clue.text: Sussex town luminary eats sandwiches

indicators.note: the words luminary eats sandwich the answer between them, holding it inside

explanation.surface: A celebrity from a Sussex town eats sandwiches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sandwiches' looks like food the luminary eats but is the verb that hides the answer. The town is a small medieval port in East Sussex, England.
explanation.definitionFit: The historic Cinque Ports town on the East Sussex coast is a Sussex town.

clue.text: Initially Prince Harry agrees forecast

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of Prince
to harry is to harass or disturb, so the letters of agrees are disturbed

explanation.surface: Prince Harry agrees with a prediction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prince Harry' reads as a royal name; Harry is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To foretell or be a warning sign of something to come is to forecast it.

clue.text: Boring routine of lady leaving hospital

indicators.note: the hospital letter is leaving, so it is dropped

parts.note: Ruth is a woman's name
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A woman leaving hospital returns to her humdrum daily round.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove worn by repeated wheels gives the idiom for a dull, unchanging habit.

clue.text: Hidden article in building on street

indicators.note: the article and building come on, after, the street

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
a shed is a simple building

explanation.surface: Something hidden in a building on a street.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stored away secretly in a hiding place has been hidden.

clue.text: Drunken sea dog in coastal location

indicators.note: drunken suggests the letters stagger about in a new order

explanation.surface: An old sailor, drunk, in a seaside place.
explanation.definitionFit: The Californian city on the Pacific near the Mexican border is a coastal location.

clue.text: Sceptic is entertained by Hatter, not completely mad

indicators.note: is is entertained by, held inside, the other letters
mad suggests the letters are crazily mixed up
not completely means the last letter of Hatter is dropped

explanation.surface: An unbeliever is the guest of Alice's not-quite-mad Hatter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not completely' drops the R of Hatter; 'mad' turns HATTE into ATHET, and IS goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: One who disbelieves in God is a religious sceptic.

clue.text: In which three lovers linger and alternate excitedly?

definitions.text: In which three lovers linger and alternate excitedly?

indicators.note: excitedly suggests the letters jump about into a new order

explanation.surface: A love triangle where three people dally and take turns in a frenzy.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic situation involving three people, one loved by two, is a classic love triangle.

clue.text: You don't say recover having swallowed ecstasy

indicators.note: the recover word swallows the ecstasy letter, taking it inside

parts.note: to rally is to recover
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone recovers after taking drugs, to general surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are exclamations of surprise or disbelief at what one has just been told.

clue.text: Misrepresented Queen songs

parts.note: to have misrepresented facts is to have lied
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The rock band Queen's songs were misrepresented.
explanation.definitionFit: German art songs for voice and piano, as by Schubert, are this plural term.

clue.text: Theatre skill doubled energy in comic dialogue

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre
art is skill, as in the art of persuasion

indicators.note: doubled means the energy letter appears twice

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Theatrical skill working twice as hard in a comedy script.
explanation.definitionFit: Quick witty exchange of retorts between speakers is a comic form of conversation.

clue.text: Disclose when head departs college

indicators.note: the head, the first letter, departs from the disclose phrase

parts.note: to let on is to disclose a secret

explanation.surface: A college reveals its secrets once the headmaster leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous English boarding school near Windsor is formally styled a college.

clue.text: Emperor, okay at heart, lives on in retirement

indicators.note: at heart means take the middle letters of okay

parts.note: is means exists or lives

indicators.note: in retirement means the on word retreats, read backwards

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in letters

explanation.surface: An emperor who is basically fine lives on after stepping down.
explanation.definitionFit: The German title for an imperial ruler, from Caesar, is an emperor.

clue.text: Company, extremely loyal, that is dog

indicators.note: extremely means take the extreme letters, first and last, of loyal

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A faithful companion, very loyal: that's a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish sheepdog breed, such as the Border variety, is a dog.

clue.text: Warmer in Inverness unusually

indicators.note: in signals that the answer sits within the words Inverness unusually

explanation.surface: Remarks that the weather in a Scottish Highland city is uncharacteristically mild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Warmer' looks like a comparative adjective about the weather but is a noun: the thing that warms.
explanation.definitionFit: The star that heats the Earth is the great warmer of the planet.

clue.text: Dope pockets pound in depressed Scots area

indicators.note: the dope word pockets the pound letter, holding it inside

parts.note: dope and gen are both slang for information
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A drug dealer pockets money in a deprived part of Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressed' suggests a gloomy region; it means low-lying.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow Scottish valley is a sunken, low-lying piece of land.
